about_the_game: Nautic XP. The ultimate ship simulation! Navigate realistic sceneries with advanced physics, real seamarks, and dynamic weather. Various ships with detailed systems. Realistic navigation & AI ship traffic. Challenging missions: rescue, transport & towing. Set sail now!

name: Nautic XP Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 Home
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12500H (or similar)
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 Home
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-13700HX (or similar)
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4070 (12GB VRAM) or AMD RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
